'''Dannik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tarasin]] who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was a teenager during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After there were some riots in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gadrin]], Dannik and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Kal (Human)|Kal]] were sent by the [[Cularin Militia]] to tail the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
